prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. EDIT and radically simplify the supplied ClozDesign AI try-on concept into a functional TOOL MODAL, not a marketing page. Produce one polished flat desktop screenshot, 1536x1024 landscape. Use provided screenshot as visual and model reference; preserve neutral ivory/white/ink-black brand styling and a single acid-lime primary action. Preserve recognizable woman with short brown bob, ivory T-shirt, butter-yellow trousers as main preview, and same diverse model thumbnails.

CRITICAL USER FEEDBACK: REMOVE ALL marketing headline, explanatory description, 'Your design. Real presence.', 'Choose a model. Bring your T-shirt to life.', 'Find your look', step numbers, workflow footer, large typography, taglines, eyebrow text, decorative captions, and redundant labels. This is a compact productive tool, no onboarding or promotional copy. Minimal only necessary short functional labels.

SHOW A REAL CENTERED MODAL on top of the dimmed existing product detail page. Background visible only as narrow margins around modal: subdued blurry ClozDesign navigation and an ivory 3D T-shirt detail page under dark translucent overlay. Foreground modal approx x=140 y=100 width=1256 height=824, restrained 12px outer radius and soft substantial shadow, white surface. Absolutely no page heading outside modal. No duplicated navigation within modal.

MODAL HEADER 54px high: small restrained 18px sans-serif 'AI Try-on' at left, simple X close button at right, hairline bottom border. This title is purely a functional window label, not a promotional headline.

MODAL BODY fills remaining height, TWO COLUMNS: large LEFT image workspace approximately 68% width, RIGHT control panel about 32% width with a thin vertical border. Dense practical controls, excellent visual hierarchy and enough spacing; all controls fit in modal.
LEFT preview: light warm-grey neutral stage with no separate card border, full-height fashion model image of same woman wearing ivory oversized T-shirt and yellow trousers, complete hair and head down to upper thighs, centered, large and clear. At stage top-center a compact segmented 'Original' / 'Try-on' switch, 'Try-on' active black. At bottom-right two small white square icon buttons for enlarge and download; subtle icon-only toolbar. At bottom-left tiny unobtrusive 'AI generated' provenance badge. NO floating model-name card, no source garment inset (source garment belongs in right panel), no fake dimensions or brand badges, no title overlay.

RIGHT panel top: compact horizontal garment input row, 62px ivory T-shirt thumbnail, short label 'Garment', name 'Relaxed Crewneck', small underlined 'Edit'. Hairline divider. Below 'Model' small functional 14px semibold section label and a dropdown 'All styles' on right. Next a THREE-column by THREE-row gallery of NINE portrait model thumbnails, different real young adult fashion models and T-shirts, men and women, diverse ethnicities. Images about 90x110, small consistent gaps, names optional single small line e.g. Freja, Leo, Imani, Mara, Noah, Sofia, Alex, Jade, Finn; no subtitles. Selected first thumbnail is woman from reference wearing original cobalt-blue T-shirt, indicated with sharp black outline and tiny lime check circle. Other thumbnails use different naturally posed models. Gallery clean and practical, not a series of oversized cards. Beneath small 'Upload photo' text button with upload icon, enough separation from thumbnails.
At bottom right fixed within panel: full-width rectangular acid-lime button 48px high labeled 'Generate try-on' with simple small sparkle icon. No arrow needed. No text below button, no usage estimates, no invented pricing, no paragraphs. The modal must have enough breathing room and no wasted marketing space.

Pixel crisp believable web UI, consistent sans-serif functional typography 12-18px, no serif headline anywhere within modal, beautiful fashion photography as the visual focus. No charts, decorative shapes, purple gradients or excessive rounded pills. Render just finished screenshot.
